messages:
maya: Quick sync — localization handoff for the metered pricing calculator microcopy. Need translations + contextual variants for EU/JP. Goal: fewer FAQ tickets, better CTA clarity on mobile.

sam: Nice — primary metric is calc completion rate and support ticket count. Secondary: CTR on CTA. Who owns the source strings?

maya: ana owns copy. I'm bundling the canonical key list below. We'll need short/long variants, a 1-line mobile version, and contextual help text for 'committed discounts' and 'burst capacity'.

ana: (typo) ana: Got it. Posting suggested English strings now. Will add tone notes.

ana: "Estimate monthly cost" -> short: "Estimate cost"; mobile: "Estimate"
"Avg prompt length (tokens)" -> mobile: "Avg tokens"
"Committed discount" -> mobile help: "Save with commit"
"Start free trial" -> alt: "Try free"

leo: I can do JP/FR/DE. Any hard character limits? Mobile CTAs should be <= 14 chars ideally. Also: do we need polite/formal variants for JP?

taylor: UI constraint: CTA container collapses at 320px. Prefer single-word CTAs if possible. Avoid 2-line CTAs on small screens. Also confirm whether we want sentence-case or title-case across languages.

ana: Tone: straightforward, default to sentence-case. For JP we should use neutral polite. For FR/DE neutral-formal.

maya: Good. Here's the canonical i18n keys (send these to engineering after translations):
```
pricing.calc.title=Estimate monthly cost
pricing.calc.cta.primary=Estimate cost
pricing.calc.cta.alt=Try free
pricing.calc.input.avg_tokens=Avg prompt length (tokens)
pricing.calc.help.committed=Committed discount — commit to save up to X%
pricing.calc.note.burst=Burst capacity may incur extra charges
```

sam: We'll run an A/B test: (A) shorter CTAs vs (B) longer descriptive CTAs. Also route users who open the calculator >30s but don't complete to a microsurvey. Can marketing own the experiment copy?

maya: Yes. sam — please own experiment setup. Add inbound routing: users with trial intent should be labeled `lead:high-intent` and routed to SDR flow. CS bot stats?

cs-bot: 3 tickets in the last 7 days referencing "where is the billing calculator" and 6 mentions asking "how is billing estimated". Top page referrer: /pricing.

leo: Timeline: I can deliver JP/FR/DE + contextual notes by 1718680808 (one week). Need final source strings by EOD tomorrow.

ana: I'll finalize microcopy variants today and attach a short rationale doc.

taylor: I'll update the Figma frame and provide mobile screenshots for QA by EOD + link the component. Link: https://figma.com/s/example-pricing-calc (placeholder).

maya: ACTIONS: leo -> translations, ana -> finalize source strings, taylor -> Figma + screenshots, sam -> set up experiment + inbound routing, maya -> coordinate QA and launch. Tag me in deliverables. :thumbsup:

sam: adding tracking plan for events: `calc_open`, `calc_submit`, `calc_abandon`, `calc_support_click`. Will post the tracking spreadsheet shortly.

maya: Thanks all — small, fast rollout. We'll run for 2 weeks and review support + conversion.

(edited)
